message.content:
1. The background color of the monthly subscription plans section is **dark navy blue** (exact hex: #0a2647 or similar deep navy).  
2. The subscription plan cards are **white cards with colored headers** (Starter: teal header, Professional: blue header, Business Partner: orange header). The card bodies are white, not solid colored.  
3. Exact button texts:  
   - Starter: "GET STARTED"  
   - Professional: "UPGRADE NOW"  
   - Business Partner: "JOIN NOW"  
4. Feature bullet points/circles:  
   - Starter: Teal (matches header)  
   - Professional: Blue (matches header)  
   - Business Partner: Orange (matches header)  
5. Price text inside plan cards: **White** (contrasts with colored headers).  
6. Tagline "INSIGHT. STRATEGY. SUCCESS.": **Orange** (matches the orange accent color in the design).  
7. Subtitle "ONE-TIME REPORTS & SERVICES": **Teal** (matches the Starter plan’s header color).  
8. Table header background color: **Dark navy blue** (same as the monthly subscription section background, hex: #0a2647).  
9. Service row icons: **All the same teal color** (consistent across all service rows).  
10. "MOST POPULAR" badge: **Not visible** in the subscription section.  
11. Coin/stack icon: **Yes**, there is a gold coin/stack icon in the "PRICE LIST" header (next to the "ONE-TIME REPORTS & SERVICES" subtitle).  
12. Footer layout: **One row** (contains 4 columns: "PROFESSIONAL QUALITY REPORTS", "FAST TURNAROUND", "100% CONFIDENTIAL & SECURE", "ACTIONABLE RECOMMENDATIONS") with contact info below.
